scores.evidence: There are three can-do objectives with Bloom levels: o1 analyze 「見分け…選べる」, o2 understand 「説明できる」 and o3 apply 「確かめられる」. Every objective has an inline question and an exam question: o1 has q2, q4, p1–p3 and e1; o2 has q3, e3 and e4; o3 has q1 and e5. Apply and analyze items are present (q1, q2, q4, p1–p3, e1, e5), and e1 and e4 are transfer items.

hook-problem gives a concrete scenario in three sentences (「朝に『テストは `npm test` で実行して』と伝えたのに、午後のClaudeは別のコマンドを試します」) and follows it with the ungraded predict question q0. Each distractor in q0 encodes a misconception (learning, stronger words, a bug). sum-hook answers the same scenario at the end.

The prerequisites list 第1回–第4回. Terms carried over from earlier lessons are recalled with their lesson number: s1-lead 「第1回で見たコンテキストウィンドウ」, s1-context 「第1回のCLAUDE.mdなど」, and the s3-defs and s4-defs entries marked （第1回）／（第4回）. New terms are defined before use (コンテキスト圧縮 in s2-defs, ルール/`paths:` in s3-defs, API, CSV, WSL). Two terms appear without a recall: プランモード (s3-diagram, e3, card-survive) and the 「信頼の確認」 in pr-start.

The course measure reports 「prose 1942 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 3227 · practice reading 1115 · questions 12 · practice sections 1 · est 19.6 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」, so estMinutes 20 matches. Strict lint is clean, and every screen has a heading, a table, the diagram or a check. 5-2 is still dense: it covers /clear, /compact, auto compaction, a focus example and --continue/--resume in one segment.

s5-steps is a five-step worked example placed before practice. Each step has a subgoal label (症状を書き出す → パターンに当てはめる → 対処を選ぶ → わかったことを集める → 最初の依頼を書き直す) and a reason (ex-learn: 「`/clear` で会話が消える前に…メモします」; ex-fix cites the official advice). It ends in a rewritten prompt (s5-prompt). There is no faded step between the example and practice, and ex-learn's 「ずれた行の例」 does not appear as a concrete condition in s5-prompt.

Inline checks appear in 5-1, 5-2, 5-3, 5-5 and practice, so no two content sections in a row lack one. The checks ask for application, not word matching. q1 requires a before/after comparison the text never states. q2 no longer carries the 「関係のない」 cue (「次は、READMEを英語に翻訳してもらいます」). q4 asks the learner to pick an actual restart prompt for a new case (郵便番号, 全角数字). Every wrong option has feedback.

All five misconceptions in the brief are encoded in distractors, and each is corrected in two sentences or fewer. More context is better: q2-b, p1-d. Reopening empties the session: q2-d, p2-c, p3-d. Compaction removes all or nothing: q3-a, q3-c, e3-b, e3-d. Stronger words fix it: q0-c, q4-a, e5-a. Asking Claude for usage: q1-d. The e3 key is now unambiguous (「圧縮の直後に、ディスクから自動で読み直されるもの」), and option d's feedback explains the on-demand reload.

There is one state-change diagram (s3-diagram) with 6 nodes in Japanese, a takeaway caption (「会話は要約に置き換わり、決まったファイルの指示はディスクから戻る」) and alt text. s3-table now adds only the two rows the diagram lacks, and there are no decorative images. However, node C and the alt text still label the re-injected set 「ファイルに書いた指示」. That conflicts with the corrected s3-lead and caption (「決まったファイルの指示」) and with s3-table, which says `paths:` rules, also instructions written in files, are summarized away.

The practice is authentic. First, three session diagnoses with hints (p1–p3). Then a hands-on run in a scratch repository (pr-code) with three /context measurements, a prediction step (pr-predict, with a hint) and a focused /compact. A visible CLAUDE.md rule (「練習：」) is set against a chat-only rule (「変更したファイル：」). Success criteria are in pr-checklist (6 items) and the model answer in pr-answer. pr-prompt-b's expect warns that Claude's self-report must be checked. The hint ladder is only one level deep.

The summary comes after the exam. It has: an answer to the hook (sum-hook), 4 takeaways (sum-points), a reflection and next step (sum-next 「会話だけで何度も伝えている指示を、1つ書き出してみましょう」 leading to 第6回), 8 flashcards (sum-cards) and askTutor suggestions (sum-ask).

The version is pinned (s1-lead 「2026年10月時点（Claude Code v2.1.304）」) and sources are dated 2026-10-20. All five fixes the audit confirmed are applied: p2-d 「何が大事かをClaudeが推測して要約します」, e4-b, s3-lead 「直下のCLAUDE.mdなど、決まったファイルの指示」, pr-start trust dialog, and s2-session 「前の会話の履歴が戻ります」. The s3-table recent-files row now follows the page (「最近変更されたものから順に、5つまで」). The Japanese link is a listed source (cc-context-window-ja). The same broad wording the audit flagged in s3-lead remains in the s3-diagram label and alt text (raised under visual) and in some feedback (see niceToHave).

The text uses です・ます throughout, warmly and without pressure (「まず予想してみましょう」, 「この2点で確かめましollow」 in pr-prompt-b). There are no banned phrases, and katakana terms carry English on first use (デプロイ（deploy）, リポジトリ（repository）). Terminology drifts slightly: s2-defs names 「自動のコンテキスト圧縮」, but p2-d, the p2 explanation and e4-b say 「自動の圧縮」.

The lesson is jp-only and complete. The diagram labels are Japanese and it has alt text. The only link has descriptive text (「コンテキストウィンドウの公式ドキュメント（日本語）」). The plain-text fields (checklist labels, captions, step titles, askTutor) contain no markdown, and nothing is baked into images.

mustFix.issue: Node C and the alt text label what is re-injected from disk as 「ファイルに書いた指示」 (alt: 「ファイルに書いた指示はディスクから読み直されて」). The audit confirmed this same wording as an overclaim in s3-lead (cc-context-window: 'Path-scoped rules and nested CLAUDE.md files … compaction summarizes them away'), and s3-lead was fixed. The diagram now contradicts the corrected s3-lead, its own caption and the s3-table row that follows, which says `paths:` rules are summarized away. A learner can conclude that every instruction file comes back.
mustFix.fix:
In code, change node C's first line from 「ファイルに書いた指示」 to 「決まったファイルの指示」, so it reads C["決まったファイルの指示
直下のCLAUDE.md・paths:のないルール
自動メモリ・プランモード（plan mode）の計画"]. In alt, replace 「会話とツールの出力、ファイルに書いた指示の2つに分かれる図。ファイルに書いた指示は、」 with 「会話とツールの出力、決まったファイルの指示の2つに分かれる図。決まったファイルの指示は、」 and replace 「ファイルの指示はディスクから読み直されて」 with 「決まったファイルの指示はディスクから読み直されて」. Leave the caption unchanged.

niceToHave: s5-prompt: ex-learn promises three conditions (「ずれた行の例、CSVの日付の書き方、どのタイムゾーン」), but the prompt fills in only two. Replace the third line with 「前に試したときは、{{ずれた行の例}} の日付が1日ずれました。」 and add var {"name": "ずれた行の例", "hint": "例：2026-10-20,1200 の行"}. This also matches the lesson q4 teaches (include the failing example).
Term consistency with s2-defs: write 「自動のコンテキスト圧縮」 instead of 「自動の圧縮」 in pr-diagnose p2 option d feedback, the p2 explanation and check-quiz e4 option b feedback.

factual doubt (the same broad wording as the audited s3-lead): s3-check q3 option b feedback 「指示がファイルにあれば、圧縮のあとも戻ってきます。」 → 「指示が直下のCLAUDE.mdにあれば、圧縮のあとも戻ってきます。」; check-quiz e4 option b feedback 「ファイルに書けば、圧縮のあとに自動で読み直されます。」 → 「直下のCLAUDE.mdに書けば、圧縮のあとに自動で読み直されます。」; sum-points[2] 「圧縮のあと、CLAUDE.mdや自動メモリは」 → 「圧縮のあと、直下のCLAUDE.mdや自動メモリは」.
プランモード is used in s3-diagram, e3 and card-survive without a recall. In check-quiz e3 option c, write 「プランモード（第3回）で書いた計画」, or add 「プランモード（第3回）の計画も、ディスクから戻ります。」 to s3-lead.
e4 asks the learner to apply o2 in a new team setting. Set its bloom to "apply" so that o2 also has an apply-level item.
5-2 holds two ideas (choosing /clear or /compact, and reopening a session). Consider moving s2-session and s2-code into 5-1 after s1-defs, where セッション is defined, to lighten 5-2.
pr-steps-start pr-start: 「信頼の確認」 is not recalled. Suggested expect: 「初めてのフォルダなので、フォルダを信頼するかの確認（第1回）が出ます。承認すると、Claude Codeの入力欄が表示されます。」.
summary: A full review was required: the scope check exited 1 because objectives o1 and o3 changed and 45 of 48 blocks changed. All five must-fix items from round 1 are gone: estMinutes is now 20 against an est of 19.6, q2 has lost its cue, q4 is rewritten, the e3 key is unambiguous, and the s3-table row follows the source. The checks, misconception feedback and hands-on practice are now strong. The one remaining fix: the s3-diagram node label and alt text still say 「ファイルに書いた指示」 come back from disk, which contradicts the corrected s3-lead and s3-table; change it to 「決まったファイルの指示」.
